items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Fess had one, he said he liked the tone.

ctx.x: Is there anything about picking a guitar or even what make you prefer, not to return to make any, commit to commercial, and recommend one over the other? Well, no.

I just wanted a few. There's a good guitar as you can play. I played Martin. Martin is a very good guitar. In fact it was the Tops at one time. Fess had one, he said he liked the tone. They're very good. It's a very thin material. Then Fess got a fancy Gibson with the big sound holes like the violin. Yes. No.
But he liked it as well as the old Martin with the round holes. No. The guitars with the hole has a tendency to, how do I put it, throw out the sound more than
